choices: A List of Integer or any subtype of Integer
A List of Integer or any supertype of Integer (Number, Object, etc.)
explanation: '? super Integer' is a lower-bounded wildcard — accepts List<Integer>, List<Number>, List<Object>. You can safely add Integer elements (they satisfy the lower bound). Reading gives Object (the only guaranteed common type). Mnemonic: PECS — Producer Extends, Consumer Super.
